correctness.rationale: For a surviving monomial write the net exponents at the two sites as w and z. Its relative-phase Fourier frequency is z and its degree is at least |w|+|z|. Modulation forces m|z; multiplying by the finite center forces N|w+z; scalar-circle invariance instead forces w+z=0. Any z≠0 thus costs at least 2m if w+z=0 and at least N otherwise. These constraints apply monomial-by-monomial by independence of the characters and coordinate monomials. The orbit sum Q_d achieves 2m and the holomorphic I_N achieves N; restriction of Q_d is a single exponential unless 2d=0, when its two conjugate terms produce nonconstant 2a²b²cos(2θ). This includes N=2 as well as composite separations. Independently minimizing |w|+|z| for w,z=-N..N subject to the weight rules confirmed both lower-cost formulae for all 378 (N,d) with 2<=N<=28. Replay proof: frozen RESULT.md lines 23–53; CHECK.py is an inspected finite witness/congruence check, not a proof or a replay used for this audit. For primes p, projective phase blindness below 2p holds on the whole two-site family, not on generic signals; variation alone need not imply complete phase-orbit separation.
